name: Regulatory Reporting Type 1 Code
definition: Identifies whether the regulatory reporting information applies to the debit side, to the credit side or to both debit and credit sides of the transaction.

CRED.name: Credit
CRED.definition: Regulatory information applies to the credit side.

DEBT.name: Debit
DEBT.definition: Regulatory information applies to the debit side.

BOTH.name: Both
BOTH.definition: Regulatory information applies to both credit and debit sides.
